html:
Mouth Guards

Comfortable Mouth Guards in Kansas City, MO

Cosmetic and Implant Dentistry Westport delivers maximum comfort and safety by developing dental mouth guards for patients in Kansas City, MO. Patients request dental guards for many reasons, including protecting themselves during sports, reducing snoring, and balancing the jaw and teeth. Whether you want to improve safety on the court or during sleep, you can rely on us to provide the perfect solution for your needs. We design dental protection with the latest materials and technology. They are intended exclusively for the user's mouth. Face the most challenging impacts while keeping your teeth secure and in place. We'll provide restorative and preventative dental solutions made just for you.
Contact Us

Customized Mouth Guards

Our dentists customize mouth guards for patients. Shaped to fit the patient's mouth size and proportions, our guards provide more comfort and relief than standard guards. They are designed to do the following, keeping teeth and gums in excellent condition:

  • Prevent your teeth from getting knocked out or broken or becoming loose.
  • Prevent chips, cracks, and other damage.
  • Prevent trauma and impact upon the gums, cheeks, pulp, and soft tissue.
  • Soften the impacts of blows to the face.
  • Reduce jaw tightening, teeth grinding, and TMJ.
  • Reduce heavy breathing and snoring during sleep.
  • Minimize the chances of sustaining a mouth injury.

Prepare Your Mouth With Us

Cosmetic and Implant Dentistry Westport's mouth guards can potentially save you time and money in the long run. Since they are protective, they can prevent impacts from damaging your teeth. They significantly reduce the chances of needing a more complex restorative or cosmetic procedure. If you want confidence and peace of mind, we recommend considering a mouth guard and its benefits. Our team will happily consult with you and learn more about your daily activities and dental condition. We can develop a unique solution based on your lifestyle. We aim to make your activities and daily life safer and easier.

Choose Us for the Perfect Smile

Call Now
